snippet.title: Party Golf Trailer
snippet.description:
Available for PS4:

North America
https://store.playstation.com/#!/en-us/games/party-golf/cid=UP1250-CUSA06847_00-6664666366626661

Europe
https://store.playstation.com/#!/en-au/games/party-golf/cid=EP1246-CUSA05568_00-6664666366626661

and Nintendo Switch:

North America
https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/party-golf-switch

Europe
https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Party-Golf-1293242.html

and Steam:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/538550

Party Golf is less golf, more party; crazy, competitive couchplay action for one to eight players. 

Tee off together in a dynamic 2D world, in a frenetic free-for-all race to the hole. It’s instant, physics-based fun with endless variety; trillions of gameplay combinations, from banana balls to turbo powerups.
